title: Adaptive JSON parameter recovery and developer-facing error signals
creator: Arjun Patel
description: Deliver a pragmatic RFC and implementation plan for an adaptive JSON parameter recovery layer and a standardized, developer-friendly error signal surface for function/tool calls. Goals: (1) define a compact on-wire JSON parameter definition format that supports optional hints, coercion profiles, and named recoverability levels; (2) specify runtime validation stages (pre-apply lint, strict validation, adaptive-repair attempt, final rejection) and the exact actions taken in each stage; (3) design the structured error payload schema and consistent error codes (including mapping to HTTP 4xx/5xx where applicable) so SDKs and console tooling can present actionable guidance; (4) wire telemetry and sampling so we can iterate on repair heuristics without impacting latency SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: RFC reviewed and approved by infra and API teams
Validation pipeline implemented with toggles for each stage (lint, strict, repair, reject)
Structured error payload schema published and used by at least one SDK mapping layer
Graceful fallback behavior documented: when a repair succeeds, original request preserved in audit log; when it fails, error contains remediation hints and sample rewrite
End-to-end tests cover dirty-field coercion, missing-required, unknown-field, and type-mismatch errors with expected error codes and metrics
implementation_notes: Introduce compact 'paramHints' in call manifest: {coerce:string|none|best-effort, level: strict|lenient|repairable, example:<short-string>}
Add a two-pass validator in the runtime: fast lint (non-blocking) -> strict validate (blocking) -> optional repair using lightweight heuristics -> emit structured error on reject
Repairs should be bounded by token/time budget (configurable per-customer) and produce a repair_provenance entry in the response metadata
Expose feature flags per-tenant: repair_enabled, repair_budget_ms, repair_aggressiveness
SDKs should translate internal error codes to human messages and include CLI 'replay --with-fixes' helper to surface suggested rewrites
test_plan: Unit tests for validator transitions and deterministic repair steps
Integration tests against the hosted runtime with simulated model responses to confirm KV cache and prefix caching are preserved
Chaos tests where repair stage is enabled and runtime experiences high load to confirm latency SLO fallback to strict reject path
Regression checks that ensure previously supported shortform param synonyms still resolve under permissive profiles
telemetry_changes: Add breadcrumb: repair_provenance (short encoded diff) to error traces when repair attempted
